game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what vultures changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what vultures changed. Each round, vultures strike the palm grove, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_clarity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the palm grove from vultures in Caravan Camp: keep the trace_clarity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: trace_clarity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_clarity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Caravan Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while trace_clarity > 0.
